purpose: Describe recorded baseline gates before rule alternatives; no new tester or simulation
baseline: snapshot.decision only, never substitute A2/A3 policy verdicts
timestamps: First observed in this cohort for qualified/confirming/triggered/plannable and first recorded plan; never assert first ever
duplicate_policy: Repeated identical boundary ignored; conflicting same-boundary or out-of-order records rejected
unknown_policy: Missing facts remain null; no reconstruction of unselected setups, actual retest contact, counterfactual fills or profitability
evaluation: Recorded January2024 is reused descriptive evidence, not fresh validation or a strategy contest
